notes: A CHEQUE CLEARS ONCE, AND A MATCH HAS TO ADD UP. On one real August statement the bank printed the same cheque number on two lines of the same day - 3,035.25, which really was that cheque, and 35,910.00, which was a different cheque. The Match dialog offered the same cheque for both, and its Match anyway button never asked whether the figures agreed, so the real 35,910.00 cheque stayed unpresented and the month would not sign off. NOW an item another statement line has already matched is shown but cannot be picked again, and an item for a different figure is offered only as part of several that add up to the bank's line - two cheques paid as one line still work as before. The ledger holds both rules itself. IF YOUR RECONCILIATION IS STUCK ON A FIGURE LIKE THIS, look for two lines matched to one cheque, unmatch the wrong one and match it to the cheque it really is. Installing: no data changes and no ledger entries. Installs over the previous version - please still take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
